text:
ashley: Quick thread: proposal to add an adaptive router for console renders that chooses between streaming micro-renders and batched tiles based on size+sensitivity+recent latency.

kevin: Sounds good. Question: where do RBAC checks live? upstream (ingress) or per-renderer?

maria: Upstream preferred to avoid accidental leaks. Ingress returns a signed perm-hash blob attached to the request.

chao: Signed perm-hash workable, but need TTL and rotation. Also shards should validate on miss and backoff.

ashley: Proposal: perm-hash TTL=30s, HMAC with key rotation (accept last 2 keys). Include perm-version in cache key.

kevin: Routing heuristics: if widget.estimated_ms < 40ms and sensitivity!=high -> stream; else -> batch. Frontend can annotate estimated_ms or backend EWMA fallback.

maria: To reduce auth volume classify widgets: low-sensitivity allow post-filtering if metrics-only; high-sensitivity require pre-auth. Product to add sensitivity flag.

tomas: Observability: emit render.path, p50/p95/p99, auth_calls_per_render, cache_hit. Alert if p95_stream>300ms or auth_error_rate>0.5%.

security: Don't log user ids; perm-hash must be non-reversible. Review key rotation policy.

chao: For mixed dashboards, frontend should batch adjacent small widgets into one /render/batch payload to reduce router hops. We'll provide a batching shim.

ashley: Rollout: feature-flag "adaptive-render-v1", canary 5% tenants -> 25% -> 100% with automatic rollback if p95 increases >15% or errors spike.

deploy-bot: feature-flag "adaptive-render-v1" created at 1762601400, targeting 5% tenants.

sre-bot: synthetic-canary started at 1762601450 comparing monolith vs adaptive for 250 dashboards. Reporting to #incidents.

kevin: I'll draft a short RFC with API shapes and cache-key examples by Tue.

maria: I'll prototype perm-LRU and share perf numbers.

ashley: Thanks all, will close thread when RFC lands.
